provenance: Synthetic journeys from journey-2.0. Zero measured training cases.
grouping: Both branches and every sampled time from one parameter draw remain together; exact predictive configurations are unique.
primary_metric: Mean absolute error over 8 outputs, both branches and 16 time points, with each trajectory equally weighted.
calibration: 90% split-conformal simultaneous envelope over all 8 outputs, both branches and sampled times per case. Exchangeability applies only to this synthetic in-domain sampling distribution.
selection: Choose family by validation MAE; frozen test is scored once after models, calibration and choice are saved. No test-based tuning.
ood: Low velocity [0.1,0.3) or high velocity (1.8,2.0], outside train support. Also reject any runtime parameter outside the trained support box.
budget: Each trained model gets the same minibatch size, optimizer steps and validation schedule; record parameter counts and wall time. No claim of equal FLOPs or quantum advantage.
scope: Learn simulator behavior and prioritize discriminating measurements. No clinical efficacy, MW-dependent HA biology, or automatic empirical identity of vesicles.
